pre_condition: entry_func is a non-empty string whose components are delimited by '::', representing a fully-qualified function name. The FQN corresponds to a function whose source file was extracted into extracted_functions/ and whose extracted-file path (formed by replacing every '::' with the platform path separator) can be resolved by _extracted_file_to_source_rel.
post_condition: Returns a string containing the project-relative path (using forward slashes as separators) of the source file that contains the function identified by entry_func. The returned path encodes the source module and file from which the function was extracted, with no leading or trailing whitespace.
